observations: Photo 0: A large rectangular solar panel with many dark cells; glare/flash across the surface; visible frame and junction area on the left side.
Photo 1: Another view of the same solar panel; heavy glare; watermark text across the middle.
Photo 2: Back/underside view of a solar panel with a white rear sheet; two cable ends/connectors visible near the bottom area.
Photo 3: Another back/underside view; connectors/cables visible at the bottom; no readable label shown.

claims.claim: Thank you for contacting Network Solar venture Please let us know how we can help you. We deal...
claims.evidence: Seller text is generic and does not state the specific item specs (wattage, brand/model, condition, warranty).

risks.risk: Panel wattage/size (which drives price) is not readable from the photos; could be lower or higher capacity than expected.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the panel label/sticker (brand, model, rated wattage, voltage/current) on the frame/back.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used solar panel with unknown wattage (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: Condition/health is unknown (possible cracks, delamination, hot spots, or reduced output). Photos show glare but no electrical test.
risks.proof: A working test: photo/video of an IV curve or a multimeter reading under sunlight, plus a short video showing the panel producing power.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/possibly underperforming used panel.

risks.risk: Compatibility/connection details are unknown (connector type, cable length, whether it includes MC4s or bare leads).
risks.proof: Close-up of the junction box and connector type (e.g., MC4) and cable length measurement.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming basic panel only, with no guarantee of plug-and-play.

risks.risk: Whether it is complete with mounting hardware or just the panel is unknown.
risks.proof: Photo showing everything included in the sale laid out (frame, junction box, cables, any brackets).
risks.if_unproven: Price as panel only (no extra hardware).

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the rating label/sticker (brand/model and rated wattage) on the panel frame/back.
A photo of the junction box label (if present) and connector type (MC4 or other) with cable length.
Evidence of working condition: IV curve screenshot or a simple power test under sunlight (video + readings).
Confirm what is included: panel only vs panel + cables + mounting hardware.
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a solar panel, but the key pricing driver (rated wattage/brand/model) and working condition are not readable or proven, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be set from the current images.
